name: Avg + Max Pool
tagline: Element-wise mean of global average pooling and global max pooling — combines mean and peak channel statistics.
diff_from_baseline: Common practice in image retrieval and classification (e.g., used as an ablation in fastai and image-retrieval literature). Combines the two cheapest summary statistics; no learned parameters.

name: GeM (Generalized Mean)
tagline: Learnable generalized mean pooling with exponent p; interpolates between average (p=1) and max (p->inf).
diff_from_baseline: Radenovic, Tolias & Chum 2018 (TPAMI). Standard pooling head in image retrieval (CGD, NetVLAD-style retrieval). Single learned scalar interpolates between mean and max pooling.

name: Global Max Pool
tagline: Adaptive max pooling: pick the maximum activation per channel across all spatial positions.
diff_from_baseline: Standard practice in fine-grained recognition and retrieval; selects the most salient feature per channel. Common alternative to global average pooling, especially when locality matters.
